mapper.select: SELECT * FROM vi_order WHERE order_no=#{orderNo} AND owner_account_id=#{owner} FOR UPDATE
SELECT * FROM vi_order WHERE id=#{id} FOR UPDATE
SELECT * FROM vi_payment_order WHERE order_id=#{orderId} FOR UPDATE
SELECT p.* FROM vi_integration_profile p JOIN vi_integration_revision r ON r.profile_id=p.id WHERE r.id=#{revisionId}
mapper.update: UPDATE vi_payment_order SET payment_method='WECHAT',merchant_profile_id=#{merchantProfileId},merchant_revision_id=#{merchantRevisionId},app_id=#{appId},mchid=#{mchid},policy_revision_id=#{policyRevisionId},method_locked_at=UTC_TIMESTAMP(3),prepay_request_cipher=#{prepayRequestCipher},version=version+1,updated_at=UTC_TIMESTAMP(3) WHERE id=#{id} AND version=#{version} AND payment_method='UNSELECTED' AND status='PENDING'

UPDATE vi_payment_order SET payment_method='OFFLINE',policy_revision_id=#{policyRevisionId},method_locked_at=UTC_TIMESTAMP(3),version=version+1,updated_at=UTC_TIMESTAMP(3) WHERE id=#{id} AND version=#{version} AND payment_method='UNSELECTED' AND status='PENDING' AND prepay_state='NONE' AND prepay_request_cipher IS NULL AND expires_at > UTC_TIMESTAMP(3)

UPDATE vi_payment_order SET prepay_state='REQUESTING',status='UNKNOWN',prepay_lease_token=#{token},prepay_lease_until=DATE_ADD(UTC_TIMESTAMP(3),INTERVAL 30 SECOND),version=version+1,updated_at=UTC_TIMESTAMP(3) WHERE id=#{id} AND version=#{version} AND payment_method='WECHAT' AND status IN ('PENDING','UNKNOWN') AND expires_at > UTC_TIMESTAMP(3)

UPDATE vi_payment_order SET prepay_state='READY''UNKNOWN',status=CASE WHEN status IN ('PENDING','UNKNOWN') THEN 'PENDING''UNKNOWN' ELSE status END,prepay_result_cipher=#{cipher},prepay_lease_token=NULL,prepay_lease_until=NULL,version=version+1,updated_at=UTC_TIMESTAMP(3) WHERE id=#{id} AND version=#{version} AND prepay_lease_token=#{token} AND prepay_state='REQUESTING'
mapper.select: SELECT r.out_refund_no,p.order_id FROM vi_refund_order r JOIN vi_payment_order p ON p.id=r.payment_id WHERE r.id=#{refundId} AND r.payment_method='WECHAT' AND r.execution_mode='WECHAT_API'
